_quelle: Echte TypeSafe-Antwort (jev-1.13.0) vom 29.09.2026 auf die LigaInsider-Ausfallgruende dieses Tages plus neun Vergleichsgruende. Drei Fragen je Grund (Dauer, bestimmt, gesicherte Diagnose) wie in scouts/ligainsider/severity_judge.py.

legend.0: A few days or a single match: a minor knock, a cold or other short illness, a one-match suspension, rest or load management, or not selected by the coach
legend.1: About one to three weeks: for example a muscle strain, a bruise, or a stretched ligament
legend.2: About three to eight weeks: for example a torn muscle fibre, a torn ankle ligament, or a small bone fracture in the foot or hand
legend.3: Several months or the rest of the season: for example a ruptured cruciate ligament, a ruptured Achilles tendon, a broken leg, or an operation followed by long rehabilitation
